title: Accelerating voltage relation
description: Essential: Student must use eU₀ = ½mv₀² to find initial speed after acceleration.

title: Electric field acceleration
description: Important: Student must correctly compute acceleration a = eU/(md) from parallel plate field.

title: Time of flight relation
description: Important: Student must relate plate length l to time via t = l/v₀.

title: Vertical displacement condition
description: Essential: Student must apply y = ½at² with y = d/2 (just misses plates).

title: Plate length expression
description: Essential: Final answer for part (1) must be l = d√(2U₀/U).

title: Energy addition principle
description: Important: Student must recognize kinetic energy increases by work done by field: ΔE = e·(U/2).

title: Final kinetic energy
description: Essential: Final answer for part (2) must be E_k = e(U₀ + U/2).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Using wrong sign for electron charge in force/acceleration expressions.

title: Incorrect displacement condition
description: Pitfall: Setting y = d instead of d/2 (electron just grazes plate, not travels full gap).
